result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall pick would be **1Password for ease of use**, or **Bitwarden if keeping costs down is more important**\.

Here's how I'd compare the leading options in 2026.

## Best password managers for small teams

![Reseña de 1Password (2026) — Pros, contras y calificación](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LhhWUKpIQMTSXlgy0rkrwkHAERgLjZW5NCI0Xc0qkbUSpwWTzEsJW5e71Kaq5cpXXWizPt5ktnTq8wPiR_oY_whlI1wTSXpy9Y6q6L9PQ5B5-G7e3wkG3IEdQWVwR8XRay6DBOKXCTQbQylBaZFlaPEM9QThG5K5RPgmWiXTqGFDVXlTrr7B7oW9lYa2JiZP?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall)

# \~\$8.99

Per user/month, annual billing

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Good admin controls and employee offboarding.
- Strong integrations with business identity providers.

Best if you want something straightforward that employees will actually use.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

# \~\$4

Per user/month, annual billing

- Open-source software.
- Shared collections and team access.
- Good security and administration features.
- Self-hosting available with the appropriate Enterprise plan.

Best if you want excellent functionality without spending too much.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

# \~\$4

Indicative Business pricing per user/month

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared folders and delegated administration.
- Good security and compliance features.

Best if you have more demanding security requirements.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

# \~\$2–5

Indicative per user/month, depending on plan

- Privacy-focused approach.
- Secure sharing.
- Email aliases and passkey support.
- Swiss-based provider.

Best if privacy and data protection are particularly important.

[Proton Pass business plans](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Prices are indicative USD prices from published 2026 comparisons, before tax. Check current UK pricing and plan features before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[vettlo.com](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[technovapartners.com](https://technovapartners.com/en/insights/best-business-password-managers-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd prioritise

For a small business, these features matter most\:

| Feature | Importance |
|--------|--------|
| Shared team vaults | Essential |
| Individual user accounts | Essential |
| Permission management | Essential |
| Easy employee onboarding/offboarding | Essential |
| Two-factor authentication | Essential |
| Audit logs | Very useful |
| SSO integration | Useful as you grow |
| Secure sharing with contractors | Very useful |


One important point: avoid sharing one master password across the whole team. Give everyone their own account and share credentials through controlled vaults.

## My recommendation

I'd shortlist 1Password and Bitwarden, trial both with a few employees, and see which feels more natural.
